author: marvelusman
quote: I almost fell asleep while playing this game. It felt like a modded version of GTA 5, with nothing particularly special or any new experiences to offer. The story was so boring, making me feel like I was stuck in an exhausting relationship and tied down by something. I'd honestly rather go back to playing GTA Online. This game is way too overrated for its reputation.
